title: The vet's card
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Tuesday. A card from the county vet: a year since the first visit, come in. Wood pins it to the corkboard beside the roster. The dog is officially about two. The vet said about a year, a year ago. The strip does the arithmetic the vet did.

panels.composition: A postcard from the vet: a cartoon dog, a line as blocks, a date. Wood's hand.

image.prompt: close on a reminder postcard from a veterinary clinic with a cartoon dog on it held in a young man's hand, black and white, no words

panels.composition: WOOD pinning it beside the roster. BARNABY watching from the bed.

image.prompt: a young man pinning a veterinary postcard to a corkboard beside a typed roster while a small dog watches from a bed, black and white, no words

balloons.text: About a year, a year ago. About two.

image.prompt: a young man looking at a small dog on a bed, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The corkboard: the vet's card among the letters, the roster, the schedule turned. The dog's year on the wall with everyone else's. He belongs to the board now.

image.prompt: a corkboard crowded with pinned papers including a veterinary postcard, a small dog asleep beneath, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen over rough blue pencil; xerox grain; stark spotting; rain in frantic vertical hatching (Arc 1's aesthetic)

notes: 'About two. Coastal.' The dog on the board.
